title: Chart range brush
description: Independent endpoints select listening days on one fixed-scale minimap.
useCase: Inspect a date interval without shifting the opposite endpoint or losing the full series.
interaction: Drag either minimap handle, or use arrow keys, Home/End and PageUp/PageDown. Escape cancels the drag.
reducedMotion: Finite transitions become immediate under reduced motion and keyboard input. Host pause disables controls; any owned drag is cancelled.
limitations: Illustrative 31-day series. Minimum interval spans two inclusive days; endpoints cannot cross. No window panning, zoom or real listening data.
look: Pale blue-grey page with a white rounded card holding a large total, a steel-blue bar chart and a minimap track with two grip handles.
motion: Dragging either minimap handle snaps it day by day while the selected window, highlighted bars, total and dates update directly; Escape mid-drag restores the previous range.
adapt: Range logic is `update` (clamps so endpoints never cross) and `finish` (restores `origin` on cancel); handle drags map pointer x to whole days through `grab`. Replace `HOURS`, the hard-coded `30` index range and the October labels with your series and dates.
